description: A day of foods and supplements (up to 200 items, at most 50 of them text; a text item costs what resolve charges for one phrase) checked against recommended intakes and upper limits for a population. Limits that apply only to supplements (magnesium, vitamin E, folic acid, niacin) are compared only with the supplement part. When an item did not resolve or lacks a value, intake is a lower bound (intake_is: at_least, missing_from, unresolved) and a status it cannot settle is unknown, never below or meets. Each finding's reference carries its source and cite line; each item in sources carries cite and its url.

fields.description: Only report findings for these nutrient keys (e.g. ["protein","sodium"]); a group name covers its keys. Default: every nutrient with a reference value.

anyOf.description: A phrase, as resolve takes it: "2 large eggs".

id.description: Entity id, e.g. fd_k3m9x2q8vt7w4p (food), pr_ (product), sp_ (supplement), mi_ (menu item), rc_ (recipe). A source id also works: fdc:<USDA fdcId>, ndb:<NDB number>, dsld:<DSLD id>, fndds:<food code>, lnhpd:<LNHPD id>, ciqual:<alim_code>, cnf:<food code>, cofid:<food code>, matvaretabellen:<food id>, slv:<Livsmedelsverket number>.

text.description: Free text instead of an id, e.g. "2 large eggs scrambled". Resolved first.

unit.description: g, oz, ml, cup, tbsp, serving, slice, capsule... Defaults to "serving" for products and supplements, "g" with quantity 100 otherwise.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale, e.g. en-US, en-GB, ja-JP. Decides household measure sizes (a US cup is 236.6 ml, a metric cup 250 ml).

jurisdiction.description: Whose reference values: US (NIH ODS RDA/AI/UL, Dietary Guidelines CDRR, FDA Daily Values) or EU (Regulation 1169/2011 RI/NRV, which UK labels also use). No other jurisdiction is held yet: CA, UK, AU and the rest are refused with this list, never answered with an empty list.

regime.description: With fields: add values derivable for this regime to every item and the totals (e.g. EU adds salt from sodium), each marked derived_from. Without it, a requested field only sodium can give is null with a reason saying so.

name: check_intake
